tob-13145: Swami Vivekananda’s seven talks on Jnana Yoga — the yoga of knowing — teach the road of sifting the true Self from the world’s passing show. Given in America in the 1890s, they bore Vedanta’s boldest word: that each soul is godlike already. The talks crackle with the Swami’s fire.
tob-0045: The Pentagon Papers are the Defense Department’s secret history of the Vietnam War, leaked by Daniel Ellsberg in 1971. This first Gravel-edition volume spans the war’s roots and buildup. The leak’s printing — and the high-court fight it lit — changed American journalism.

tob-4245: A. M. Reeves’s Wineland the Good tells of Iceland’s finding of America — the Vinland sagas in scholar’s dress. His work fastened the Norse farings in American minds. The book stays the classic tale of Leif Ericsson’s voyage. A landmark of Viking book-lore.

arxiv-2605-09245: Tracking objects across many cameras usually demands painstaking calibration. arxiv-2605-09545: Koopman operator theory lifts nonlinear dynamics into infinite-dimensional linear spaces — but only if the data cooperates. arxiv-2606-18045: H. Chakraborty and colleagues study transit timing and starspot-induced depth variations in the 17-million-year-old HIP 67522 system. arxiv-2606-18145: Shouzhen Gu, Lily Wang, and Aleksander Kubica give a polynomial-time approximation scheme for minimum-weight decoding of topological codes. arxiv-2606-18345: Marius Gerbershagen and Jakob Hollweck exponentiate higher-point and higher-genus Virasoro conformal blocks in the semiclassical limit. plos-pone-0003445: Neonatologists tested a drug to protect premature lungs in this 2008 rat study. plos-pone-0003545: Toxicologists caught a plastic chemical sabotaging stress hormones in this 2008 study. plos-pone-0003645: In 2008, a team mapped where a hormone switch lands on DNA. plos-pone-0003745: In 2008, Skinner, Anway, and Savenkova showed a grandparent's exposure reaching the grandchild's brain. plos-pone-0003845: Back in 2008, a group watched brains link sounds to actions. McNamara, Buccino, and Menz tracked the neural dynamics as volunteers learned sound-action associations. The study probes the motor roots of communication, where moving and meaning first meet.

plos-pone-0004045: In 2008, Wu and Sato studied the plumbing of a fruit-fly embryo's heart. They measured the mechanics of cardiac pumping in living Drosophila embryos. plos-pone-0004145: In 2009, Guwatudde, Wabwire-Mangen, and Eller tracked HIV in rural Uganda for years. Infection rates ran relatively low but clearly threatened to rise. The cohort study pinned down local risk factors. The warning guides prevention before the curve bends up.
plos-pone-0004245: In 2009, a team probed the old violin secret. Mineral preservatives in Stradivari and Guarneri wood shaped their sound. Chemical treatment, not just craft, made the magic. The finding rewrites the Cremona legend anew. The chemistry may guide modern instrument makers.
plos-pone-0004345: In 2009, Atkinson, Morris, and Ferrin drew maps of protein kinship. Sequence similarity networks visualized relationships across diverse protein superfamilies. plos-pone-0004445: In 2009, Grigoryan, Hall, and Durant found late HIV tests costing lives. Late diagnosis and progression to AIDS or death among injection drug users were tracked. The latecomers fared much worse. The finding urges earlier testing. The key determinants were mapped.
plos-pone-0004545: In 2009, Jeong, Kwon, and Park brewed a new brain-tumor killer. Secretable trimeric TRAIL was tested as a novel glioma therapy. The engineered protein triggered tumor-cell suicide. The early finding offers real hope. The gliomas are the most malignant brain killers.
plos-pone-0004645: In 2009, Cate, Herron, and Yund found listening lighting up vision areas. Auditory attention activated outer peripheral visual cortex. The sound-focused brains woke up visual areas anew. The neat finding maps cross-modal wiring anew. The test subjects were sighted.
plos-pone-0004745: In 2009, two researchers found exercise not stopping aging fat gain. An active life did not cut the risk of fat gain. The aging movers still gained fat indeed. The study informs obesity research today. The activity declines with age still.
plos-pone-0358945: Brain aneurysms are often treated by filling them with tiny metal coils — but sometimes blood flow returns, a dangerous reopening called recanalization. plos-pone-0343345: Pouring money into digital tech doesn’t automatically make a heavy-industry firm greener. The lesson: how you digitize matters more than how much you spend.
plos-pone-0358545: A brain bleed can steal thinking as well as movement. plos-pone-0326645: Children with special health care needs depend on policy — and policies differ wildly. plos-pone-0358445: Insulin does more than move sugar — it also triggers shedding of RAGE, an inflammation receptor, from blood vessel walls. plos-pone-0353745: Well-being in America isn’t evenly shared. plos-pone-0358245: Tiny Romulea wildflowers of the Tyrrhenian region hide cryptic diversity invisible to the eye. plos-pone-0354445: Staying active may protect aging lungs in China. plos-pone-0357045: Connected vehicles must authenticate each other securely — without revealing who’s who. plos-pone-0357445: This entry is a correction notice, not a research finding. It amends the paper on altered stress and fear responses in the VPA rat model of autism, covering behavioral differences across tactile, nociceptive, and social contexts. The correction sets the published record straight.
plos-pone-0357145: Weight loss interventions change children’s metabolism in measurable ways. plos-pone-0321345: Sterilizing cold-chain equipment and temperature-sensitive medical devices defeats most methods — heat destroys them. Chlorine dioxide gas sterilization solves the dilemma. plos-pone-0356745: Preparing the body before prostate removal — prehabilitation — may improve recovery dramatically. plos-pone-0355545: Reverse-engineering the biochemical networks inside cells from data alone is a grand challenge. This paper proposed Bayesian model discovery for exactly that task. The Bayesian approach doesn’t just fit a network — it quantifies uncertainty about which network is right.
plos-pone-0355045: Vasa previa — fetal vessels crossing the birth canal — can kill babies in minutes if unrecognized. plos-pone-0355845: India’s National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission needs universal screening to succeed. plos-pone-0355745: Reused poultry litter shapes chicks’ gut microbes and immunity from day one. plos-pone-0354145: Elliptic curve cryptography needs modular inversion — fast and constant-time. This paper implemented Kaliski’s algorithm in hardware for exactly that. The constant-time implementation closes timing side channels — the subtle leaks that let attackers steal cryptographic keys.
plos-pone-0352445: Measuring head and brain circumference from MRI — automatically, at scale — accelerates neuroimaging research. This paper built that automated extraction approach. The tool frees researchers from manual measurement — enabling population-scale studies of brain growth.
plos-pone-0345845: Korean forest tree seeds — overlooked bioresources — might yield antioxidants, anti-inflammatories, whitening agents, and anticancer compounds. plos-pone-0353945: Knowledge graphs recommending lifestyle interventions — for better body composition and strength. This paper tested such a system’s effectiveness. plos-pone-0352145: Ethiopian family planning — service receipt during facility visits from the 2021-2022 provision assessment. This paper presented the evidence. plos-pone-0352645: Geopolymer concrete’s steel bond strength — predicted by interpretable machine learning with Bayesian optimization. This paper built it. plos-pone-0351645: Cricket frass as organic fertilizer — effects on zucchini seedling establishment, growth, and fruit yield. This paper assessed it. The findings tested insect waste as crop food. plos-pone-0349145: Critically ill patients — calcium, magnesium, phosphate, and potassium supplementation in a multicenter cohort. This paper studied it. plos-pone-0337245: Rat testis staging — automated spermatogenic staging in PAS-stained tissue via deep learning, normal and atrophied. This paper built the model. plos-pone-0347045: Giant honey bees — nesting in anticipation, with spatial ecology mapped against crop succession by remote sensing. This paper studied Apis dorsata. plos-pone-0352245: Perioperative health literacy — a patient-driven intervention’s effect, in a stepped-wedge cluster randomized sub-study. This paper tested it. plos-pone-0333545: EU countries’ SDG 4 implementation — assessed with a hybrid linear ordering approach toward the 2030 Agenda. This paper did so. The analysis ranked the education goal’s progress. europmc-pmc2824145: Before running a big clinical trial, researchers test the waters with a pilot study. This 2010 tutorial explains the what, why, and how of pilot studies. europmc-pmc6512245: CAR-T therapy - reprogramming a patient's own immune cells to hunt cancer - only works well when the engineered cells get strong internal "go" signals. europmc-pmc6572845: ICU monitors stream vital signs by the second - a goldmine for machine learning if models can juggle many tasks at once. europmc-pmc6602445: For twenty years, PSIPRED has been the go-to workbench for predicting protein structures from sequence alone. europmc-pmc6704245: The human cortex - seat of thought, language, and memory - builds itself through an elaborate developmental choreography. europmc-pmc6714445: Tumors recruit fibroblasts and turn them into bodyguards that blunt immune attack.
